title: Maxwell's Equations
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state Maxwell's equations applicable to the given medium.

title: Wave Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate the condition that must be satisfied, specifically showing that omega^2 > ne^2/(m epsilon_0).

title: Magnetic Field Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the magnetic field B in terms of E0, K, and omega.

title: Wavelength Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should calculate the wavelength of the electromagnetic wave based on the derived expressions.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the derivation of the magnetic field.

title: Neglecting Forces
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should acknowledge the assumption of neglecting the magnetic force on electrons.
